Use case: illustration-story. One complete literary-room companion mother artwork, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, horizontal canvas. The view is a fictional illustrated literary room, not a claimed actual location. One person only. No new desk, extra chair, moved window, zoom, crop, room redesign, second person or extra off-camera hands. Existing lamp and cup stay on their original table.

文学瞬间：给最期待的事争取一席。
心理：她先替最想去、最想做的那一边说话，随后看见现实条件并不肯让步。她想保住期待，也肯承认代价。 兴致并非鲁莽；她不愿让喜欢的事在一张整齐安排里悄悄消失。 她还想替期待的那一边多争取一次。
目光：在两张小纸的空白与对方之间衡量，眼神有自己的倾向。 先看自己偏爱的那张，再看对方。
相处：把可改的两种过法放出来，听到对方更在意别的也能转向。 邀请对方把更想保住的一点也摆出来。
表情：轻轻皱眉，偶有想出新办法的小亮意。 眉梢微扬，认真里有一点不服气。
光线：日光让桌面开朗，纸与杯的高光收得细。

Character: Anon Chihaya / 千早愛音, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Keep the youthful identifiable anime face and ordinary student proportions of her approved input: long clear PINK hair, natural side-swept bangs, bright BLUE-GRAY eyes, fine lively youthful face. Both eyes and bangs must remain clearly drawn and visible. Faithful Haneoka clothes: pale lavender-gray school blazer, white piping and two small gold buttons, white collared shirt, dark green necktie, dark green/gold plaid skirt, dark knee socks, BLACK loafers. Preserve her own colors under the light. No borrowed face/uniform, mature model styling or chibi proportions. Modest fully clothed school-day companionship.

New PLANNING pose and real support: use the ORIGINAL LEFT WRITING DESK AND WOODEN CHAIR, not the round lamp table. She sits genuinely on that original chair at the desk opening, naturally angled enough toward the room for her three-quarter face, knees and lower legs to remain readable. The same chair can be slightly angled for occupancy, but preserve the desk footprint, original chair identity and entire room camera. Put exactly two small plain sheets side by side within the existing desk's finite work surface. One hand steadies the corner of the sheet she favors; the other holds a simple pen paused just above the other sheet. Forearms are genuinely supported by the desk and belong continuously to the shoulders. She has looked up toward the off-camera companion as if making one last lively case for the option she hopes to protect. An attentive slight frown and a spark of an alternative idea, not a broad smile. Her body remains oriented to the actual desk, without an extreme over-shoulder twist. Chair seat carries her hips, chair back remains behind the torso, knees emerge coherently from under the skirt, lower legs and both complete black shoes are visible on the real floor near the chair. No new or duplicated chair, floating stool, arm through desktop, copied chat body or decorative crossed-knee ambiguity.

Scale, anatomy and finish: keep the newly approved close-camera human scale of this same character. A bench pose can have hair top around y=110 and shoes around y=850–900, with the precise shoe depth following the real seat position; the desk pose must follow its real chair and floor perspective rather than mechanically copy bench coordinates. Never enlarge the head, lean the face toward the lens, elongate shins or shrink furniture to force a number. Keep the entire hair, hands, knees, ankles and BOTH complete shoes in frame. Basic joints and the two legs must read continuously and independently; hands have coherent fingers and wrists, no fused limbs, no furniture penetration. Natural soft local contact shadows and honest occlusion. Subtle almond-gold clear-day window light, distinct local hair/skin/clothing colors, clear gentle facial shadow planes, natural white paper and ivory fabric. Refined anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the detailed literary room, no sticker edge, gray/gold overlay or new colored spotlight. Book/paper marks are faint abstract texture only: no readable quotes, names, dates, calendar, completed task or schedule. No UI, sleep icons, speech, caption, logo, watermark, border, collage or artificial fog.
